profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Blue Origin
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer architecting large-scale, event-driven systems across aerospace, retail, and payments. Sets technical direction across 7+ teams, pioneers production AI/LLM applications, and drives enterprise-wide company goals and business impact while raising the bar on operational and engineering excellence. Recognized as a go-to architectural authority with influence engineering organizations supporting multiple spaceflight and lunar programs.

Technical Summary
* Languages: Java, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C/C++, Kotlin, Rust
* Frameworks: Spring Boot, GraphQL, React, Node, Guice, JUnit 5, Cucumber
* AI / ML: LLMs, GenAI, Harness Engineering, Spec-Driven Development, AI-Assisted Validation
* Cloud & Infra: AWS (EKS, Lambda, Synthetics, EC2, DynamoDB, MSK, API GW), Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CDK, GitLab CI/CD
* Data: Kafka, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, MongoDB, Neo4j

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical leader spanning cross-functional engineering teams responsible for manufacturing, change management, assembly and pedigree, maintenance, and quality management.  Responsible for architecture and deliverables to meet customer and company goals including orbital rockets, New Glenn, and Lunar moon lander missions.

* Architected and delivered an enterprise Event Reporting System in 2 months using a modern workflow engine, directly enabled a top tier strategy company goal and establishing the foundation for a new Quality Management System.

* Built a Change Management prototype in 6 weeks using event-driven architecture, catalyzing formation of a new Enterprise Change Management team; now processing hundreds of organizational change requests, with projected savings of thousands of engineering hours annually through early change-impact detection.

* Pioneered production AI/LLM initiatives with an LLM-based validation system resulting in a 75% productivity gain for engineers.

* Drove enterprise adoption of event-driven architecture via Kafka; patterns and reference implementations became the foundation of the enterprise data and eventing platform now used across the organization.

* Standardized observability across 7+ teams and 40+ micro-services; introduced synthetics testing and Terraform IaC tooling producing ~5,000 monitors, now default in the organization.
positions.insights: Skills: Scalability · Cloud Computing · Enterprise Software

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
* Responsible for the architecture of an engineering team of 30 for Merchandising Assortment and Financial Planning for to all 1900 nationwide stores
* Created planning products that enable planners and analysts to make data driven decisions using historical, analytical and operational datasets to determine the upcoming product assortments, contributing to billions of dollars in revenue.  
* Enable elasticity and demand forecasting Data Science models to the enterprise through scalable APIs used by multiple consumers including Price, Promo and Supply Chain.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed world class manufacturing systems for the assembly of space vehicles including New Shepard and New Glenn.  
* Managed the tracking and mitigation of thousands of manufactured components which were in nonconformance.
* Developed capabilities for receiving and inspecting parts sent from vendors.
positions.insights: Skills: Scalability · Cloud Computing · Enterprise Software

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and developed the next generation payment processing platform to process world wide traffic for millions of customers.
* Migrated over 2 billion credit cards from a secure area to AWS securely and PCI compliant with zero downtime.
positions.insights: Skills: Scalability · Cloud Computing · Enterprise Software

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Develop enterprise applications for authoring, managing and publishing promotions.
* Architected and implemented full stack solutions utilizing React, Angular, and Ember.js for user interfaces, micro services, and Neo4j.
* Integrated Apache Kafka and Apache Storm for real time publishing to Site as well as Hadoop
* Created prototypes to utilize promotional data and identify effectiveness.  
* Implemented CI/CD best practices to automate build and deployment to all environments with Chef, Jenkins and Artifactory.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Develop R&D air traffic control concept software for use in future FAA proposals.
* Worked in small teams to study, develop and analyze requirements, and create concept software    
    for new areas of air traffic control systems.
* Researched and implemented new tools such as Spring and Servicemix for more efficient and 
    agile software development.
* Developed Java swing components, messaging services, thread management, and flight   
    simulations.
* Participated in the Lockheed Martin Engineering Leadership Development Program.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked in a team to develop and test En Route Air traffic Control Software 
    for use by the FAA.  
* Implemented code to satisfy design requirements, created test documentation and collaborated    
    with other teams to develop a high quality system.  
* Manage and supported the local virtual test lab environment for software verification.  
* Responsible for installing and deleting weekly builds used by developers and testers.
* Ensure software product satisfies design requirements through software verification testing using 
    tools designed for creating flight simulations.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Provided Test and development support for En Route Air Traffic Control 
    Software.
* Implemented and modified source code for software fixes to problems, which are discovered during  
    regression and requirement testing.
* Created Aprobes, a software tool used during unit testing to modify source code during runtime.
* Developed SDD for newly defined requirements by the FAA.
